description: Provenance of every Rodin model in ObjectTalk. Waves 1-3 were generated image-to-3D with Hyper3D Rodin Gen-2.5-High through the Hyper3D MCP from inside Claude Code; wave 4 through the Rodin REST API (the same pipeline as the Object Studio). All were optimized with server/services/optimize.ts.

settings.note: Raw + glb + <=20k faces qualifies for Rodin fast mode; each generation finished in under a minute.

referencePipeline: Source: Microsoft Fluent Emoji 3D (MIT), github.com/microsoft/fluentui-emoji: single object, transparent background, consistent playful style
Review: every candidate checked by eye (whole object visible, centred, clean alpha); all 16 candidates: assets/rodin/candidates.jpg, final 5 after preparation: assets/rodin/review.jpg
Prepare: premultiplied-alpha rotate (rocket +45 deg upright, sneaker +28 deg to level the sole), trim, pad to 80%, Lanczos upscale to 1024x1024 PNG
optimization: dedup + prune + weld, centre (base at y=0), normalize largest side to 1 unit, WebP textures 1024px q82, meshopt geometry

items.prompt: A cute cartoon toy rocket standing upright, glossy white body, red nose cone and red fins, round blue window, small orange flame at the bottom, stylized 3D emoji toy style
A cute sitting teddy bear plush toy, soft orange-brown body, round ears, light tan belly and paw pads, stylized 3D emoji toy style
A cute cupcake with swirled pink frosting and colorful sprinkles in a ribbed blue paper cup, stylized 3D emoji toy style
A cute stylized running shoe sneaker, light lavender and white upper with purple side stripes, white laces, thick light purple sole, stylized 3D emoji toy style
A cute stylized purple game controller gamepad with two thumbsticks, a D-pad and four colorful round buttons, stylized 3D emoji toy style
items.notes: Generated standing up (front view reference); laid flat in-engine via catalog rotation [-90deg, 0, 0] with automatic re-seating.

waves.what: 5 hero objects (rocket, teddy bear, cupcake, sneaker, game controller)
32 models for the new levels: desk & bedroom belongings, cafe menu, Toy Town buildings and landmarks, decor
2 whole levels made by the Scene Agent (Music Room, Fruit Market)

73 models through the Rodin REST API: 10 pets (Pet Shop), 12 night-market street foods, 9 café dishes, 42 scenery props (plants, vehicles, toys, gadgets, animals); reviewed from the front and the back
